experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and built a multi-tenant order orchestration platform in Java/Spring Boot processing 500K+ orders/day across India and Middle East markets, coordinating post-order workflows between OMS, warehouse management, and logistics systems through a hybrid synchronous and event-driven architecture with idempotent message handling and retry semantics to preserve correctness under partial failure and duplicate delivery.

Designed and developed a scalable multi-tenant loyalty platform supporting omnichannel earn and redeem journeys across multiple business domains, applying domain-driven design and reusable microservice abstractions to reduce new business onboarding time-to-market by 80\%; enforced transactional consistency of point balances under concurrent earn and redeem operations.

Enhanced the organization's Kafka platform library with standardized retry and dead-letter queue mechanisms and consumer-side idempotency, improving resilience of asynchronous communication across 20+ microservices.

Led the rollout of standardized observability across 20+ microservices, implementing OpenTelemetry instrumentation, Grafana dashboards, alerting, and custom telemetry to improve production visibility, incident detection, and mean time to detection.

Orchestrated migration of 15+ backend microservices to a new AWS region, provisioning parallel infrastructure as code, reconfiguring service-to-service dependencies, and validating end-to-end correctness through integration, contract, and smoke tests in CI (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) ahead of a zero-downtime cutover.

Built an AI-driven voicebot platform handling 5k+ daily support calls, orchestrating real-time bidirectional audio over WebSockets with pluggable STT/TTS providers, barge-in handling, per-session conversation state, and latency-optimized streaming to hold sub-second response times under concurrent load.
